> 第十二章 师姐菲儿（第1页）
一场丰盛的晚宴结束后，塞恩不仅吃的肚皮滚圆，就连他的精神力与魔力也有些许增幅。
淡淡的微麻感，出现在塞恩的手臂以及身体各处伤口。
眼前这一顿由魔化生物和魔兽食材做的晚宴，竟然有这种功效，是塞恩始料未及的结果。
“看起来导师还很看重你嘛，我也很久没有吃过这么丰盛的一顿晚餐了。”
“有时候实验紧张时，都是直接喝一支营养药剂了事。”师姐菲儿对塞恩说道。
当晚宴进行到一半时，没吃几口菜品的导师摩西多和大师兄佐罗，就匆匆返回了一楼的实验室，似乎是在刚才的探讨交流中，又有了新的灵感。
因此这场师宴，塞恩主要是跟师姐菲儿吃的。
并且也是与师姐菲儿的交谈，让塞恩感受到一抹有别于黑魔法学院冰冷氛围的淡淡温馨感。
“导师真的对我恩重如山，师姐您也是这么的美丽体贴。”塞恩恭敬答道。
他并不是单纯意义的拍导师和师姐的马屁，而是真的从这短暂的接触中，感受到了有别于其它黑魔法师或学徒的氛围。
对比那些动辄喜欢把自己的学徒充作实验标本的邪恶黑魔法师，摩西多大师门下的师门氛围显然很好，这也是塞恩的运气与聪慧所在吧。
毕竟当初在公共课堂上表示看好塞恩的正式魔法师有三位，塞恩没有选择看似实力最强的安吉尼娅大师，也没有选择门下弟子众多的科索隆大师。
而是费尽心思，讨好并傍上了素来低调，从不怎么显山漏水的摩西多导师。
根据师姐菲儿的解释，塞恩知道这顿丰盛的魔兽晚餐，不仅有迅速恢复他们体力与精神力的作用，更大程度的意义在于能够帮助塞恩尽快恢复伤势。
并且塞恩作为第一次吃如此丰盛大餐的低级学徒，他所受到的好处，也远超两个师兄师姐。
就是精神力与魔力总量因此提升几个小数点，也在情理之中。
塞恩的恭维，让师姐菲儿嘴巴抿起一丝笑意。
女人不喜欢异性夸自己长的漂亮？特别是在黑魔法学院这种地方，魔法学徒之间普遍都是竞争乃至敌对关系，菲儿已经很久没有听说过类似的赞美。

塞恩不知道的是，在黑魔法学院中，高级学徒实力的菲儿，有一个“黑寡妇”的称呼。
同样都是女性高级学徒，塞恩之前接触的那个莉莉安雅虽然名气更大，但实力真不见得比他的这个师姐更强。
“我看你距离中级学徒已经十分接近，但是你的伤势，应该会让你的晋级往后推两个月，不过这也不算是件坏事。”
“导师交给你的冥想法，你转修了吗？”菲儿问道。
“暂时还没有，我今天主要翻看研究的是导师交给我的两本魔法笔记。”塞恩老实回答道。
菲儿的面庞浮现一丝赞许之意，紧接着她说道：“聪明的做法，贸然更换冥想法，你的身体还需要不少的时间适应，我建议你等晋升中级学徒后再更换。”
“而且，再过两个月就是年级考核的时候。”
“以你的实力，晋升中级学徒必然会是垫底，不如留在低级学徒阶段冲一冲名次。”
“每年的学院奖励都很不错呢，你可以试着争一争。”菲儿建议道。
师姐菲儿的建议，让塞恩认同的点了点头。

> Chapter 12 Senior Sister Feier (Page 1)
After a sumptuous dinner, Thain not only had a round belly, but his mental power and magic power also increased slightly.
A faint numbing sensation appeared on Thain's arms and wounds on his body.
The dinner in front of him, which was made of demonized creatures and Warcraft ingredients, had such an effect. It was a result that Thain had not expected.
"It seems that the instructor still values you very much. I haven't had such a sumptuous dinner in a long time."
"Sometimes when the experiment is tense, I just drink a nutrient potion to get rid of the problem." Senior sister Fei'er said to Thain.
When the dinner was halfway through, mentor Momodo and senior brother Zorro, who had not eaten a few bites of the dishes, hurried back to the laboratory on the first floor. It seemed that they had gained new inspiration during the discussion and exchange just now.
Therefore, at this senior banquet, Thain mainly ate with his senior sister Fei'er.
And it was also the conversation with his senior sister Feier that made Thane feel a touch of warmth that was different from the cold atmosphere of the Black Magic Academy.
"My mentor is really kind to me, and senior sister, you are also so beautiful and considerate." Thain replied respectfully.
He was not simply trying to flatter his mentor and senior sister, but he really felt an atmosphere that was different from other black magicians or apprentices from this brief contact.
Compared with those evil black magicians who like to use their apprentices as experimental specimens, the atmosphere in the sect under Master Mosheduo is obviously very good. This is probably where Thain's luck and intelligence lie.
After all, there were three official magicians who expressed their optimism for Thain in the public class. Thain did not choose Master Angelia, who seemed to be the strongest, nor Master Cosolon, who had many disciples.
Instead, he tried his best to please and get close to the mentor Moses who was always low-key and never showed off his talents.
According to senior sister Fei'er's explanation, Thain knew that this sumptuous Warcraft dinner not only had the effect of quickly restoring their physical and mental strength, but also had a greater significance in helping Thain recover from his injuries as quickly as possible.
And as a low-level apprentice who had eaten such a sumptuous meal for the first time, Thane received far more benefits than his two senior brothers and sisters.
It is reasonable for the total amount of mental power and magic power to increase by a few decimal points.
Thain's compliment made senior sister Fei'er curl up into a smile.
Women don’t like the opposite sex to compliment them on how beautiful they are? Especially in a place like the Black Magic Academy, where magic apprentices generally have a competitive or even hostile relationship, Mayfair has not heard similar praise for a long time.
What Thane didn't know was that in the Black Magic Academy, Mayfair, who was a senior apprentice, was known as the "Black Widow".
They are both female senior apprentices. Although Lilianya, whom Thain came into contact with before, is more famous, she is not necessarily stronger than his senior sister.
"I see that you are very close to being an intermediate apprentice, but your injury should delay your promotion by two months, but this is not a bad thing."
"Have you switched to the meditation method that your instructor gave you?" Feier asked.
"Not yet. What I mainly read and studied today are the two magic notebooks given to me by my mentor." Thain answered honestly.
A hint of approval appeared on Mayfair's face, and then she said: "It's a smart move, rashly changing the meditation method. Your body still needs a lot of time to adapt. I suggest you wait until you are promoted to an intermediate apprentice before changing."
"Besides, in two months it will be time for the grade assessment."
"With your strength, you will definitely be at the bottom if you are promoted to an intermediate apprentice. It is better to stay in the low-level apprenticeship stage and rush for the ranking."
"The academy awards every year are very good. You can try to compete for them." Feier suggested.
Senior sister Fei'er's suggestion, letThane nodded in agreement.
